history_short: Masihi Sangai chu Sihphir Presbyterian Kohhran hnuaiah a awm a, member zawng zawng pawh tel thei a nih. Pathian biak dan leh hmasawnna zawng zawng ah an inpek a nih.
history_full:
Masihi Sangai chu inkhawm dan hmang hian member te Pathian biak dan leh nungchang tha nei dan an zir a nih.

Kohhran tan thawhlawm dan zawng zawng ah an inpek a, tun dinhmun ah chuan hmasawnna a lo awm hle a nih.
